name: resource-max-segment-unleashed
title: Maximum resource segment · 1 Gbps policy
summary: Repeat maximum-efficient resource transfers with both endpoint TCP interfaces explicitly configured for the 1 Gbps MTU tier.
notes: Controlled computational comparison: identical workload and protocol, with only TCP bitrate policy changed.
description: The resource-max-segment workload repeated with both real initiator and responder TCP interfaces explicitly configured for 1 Gbps. That policy selects the 524,288-byte interface MTU tier on both stacks. Transfers still use the normal encrypted, hash-proved, application-acknowledged resource path; this is the controlled counterpart to the default-policy result, not a claim about typical deployment configuration.
conformance: Every sent transfer settles, receives its ordered application acknowledgement, and is received with exact application-byte totals and zero failures; the receiver hash-proves each resource before settlement.
